subject: Audit sprint: gameplan + leadership review kit sourcing
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit sprint: gameplan + leadership review kit sourcing

Team —

We're kicking a short, focused audit sprint to lock stage updates and assemble the leadership review kit for next quarter's QBR. Goal is a single authoritative exec pack with per-stage commit confidence and callouts for at-risk deals. Proposed schedule and asks below.

1) Timeline
- Today (Apr 18): owners confirm stage flags and populate the Stage Snapshot (attached CSV).
- Apr 22 EOD: consolidated snapshot + any 1-pager callouts due to Marissa.
- Apr 23 AM: Marissa sends consolidated exec_pack first draft to leadership.

2) What to populate in the Stage Snapshot (see attached template)
- Row per opportunity.
- Required columns: Deal ID, ARR, Stage, Owner, Commit Flag (Y/N), Commit Confidence (High/Med/Low), Next Action, Close Target Date, Notes (1-2 lines).

3) Callouts
- If a deal moves stages or the owner is unsure, add a 1-paragraph rationale in the Notes column and flag for a short 1:1 with the owner.
- For any >$100k opportunities with Low confidence, include a separate one-page remediation plan.

4) Ownership
- Owners fill their deals in the template.
- Marissa will consolidate and produce the leadership slides (I'll coordinate layout).
- Karthik: can you add a confidence guidance blurb and a quick validation against CRM tags?

Attachments: exec_pack_template_v3.pptx (layout), stage_snapshot_template.csv (fill this).

I'll schedule a 20-min sync on Apr 23 9:30am PT to review the assembled deck. If you can't make the deadline, reply here with an ETA.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit sprint: gameplan + leadership review kit sourcing

Thanks Grace — this looks good and tight, appreciate the clear asks. A couple quick notes:

- I'll take point on consolidation and will normalize ARR currencies (USD only) before I hand off the slides.
- Suggest we add one slide with last quarter vs current commit delta (top 10 deals) — helps leadership see movement.
- I can own the exec pack layout and will use the attached template as the base.

Small ask: can owners prepend a short "blockers" bullet in the Notes column if they have any third-party dependencies (legal, procurement, infra)? That will help triage.

I'll start merging submissions on Apr 22 evening and will share a draft by Apr 23 08:30 PT.

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit sprint: gameplan + leadership review kit sourcing

Thanks — I made two quick edits to the CSV and attached a filled stub for a few of my deals so owners can see format.

Questions / suggestions:
- Can we add a "Commit Confidence" guidance cell at the top of the sheet (High = documented POC, Legal signed; Medium = verbal + PO pending; Low = >1 blocker)? I'll add a sample legend in the file.
- For net-new pipeline (inbound SDR accounts), should we mark them as "unverified" until AE confirms? My preference is to include them but flag as Unverified in the Confidence column.
- Small ask: include a HubSpot link for the consolidated list so leadership can drill in. I pasted a record link in the related_links.

Attachment: stage_snapshot_filled_by_karthik.csv (sample rows + legend).

Perfect — thanks for the quick turn, both. Final alignment / assignments: 

- Owners: fill the Stage Snapshot by Apr 22 EOD. Use the legend Karthik added for Commit Confidence. Mark any unverified inbound as Unverified.
- Marissa: consolidate + normalize currencies; add last-quarter delta slide (top 10 by ARR).
- Karthik: I'll let you own the confidence legend and a quick validation pass vs CRM tags by Apr 22 noon.
- Laura: can you please review the consolidated deck after Marissa's draft? We'll aim to circulate the finalized pack to execs Apr 23 noon PT.

Upload completed CSVs and any one-pagers to the Drive link. I'll keep the 9:30am PT sync on Apr 23 but we'll only meet if there are >5 changes after consolidation.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/sales/qbr/exec_pack_template_v3
HubSpot consolidated list: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/RDW-DEAL-7789

Thanks — let's get this wrapped cleanly.
